steps.title: Welcome to the yard
lines: This is the Vesta training yard. Nothing here can hurt you.
Follow these cards, or press Leave training at any time.

steps.title: Fly through the rings

lines.screen: Move with {wasd}. Your ship turns to face the cursor.
lines.helm: Turn with {left} and {right}, thrust with {forward}. Thrust goes where the nose points.

lines: Fly through all three glowing rings.

steps.title: Stop in the zone

lines.screen: Let go to glide to a stop. Push back with {wasd} to stop sooner.
lines.helm: Let go to glide to a stop. Thrust back with {backward} to stop sooner.

lines: Come to a stop inside the marked zone.

steps.title: Shoot the practice drones
lines: Aim with the mouse and fire with {fire}.
The drones do not shoot back. Break all three.

steps.title: Mine the belt
lines: Shoot a rock in the belt around Vesta: chunks of ore break off.
Fly through the chunks to scoop them up.

steps.title: Open your hold
lines: Press {inventory} to see what you carry.
Ore you mine goes into the hold.

steps.title: Dock at the yard
lines: Fly into the yard station's docking ring, then press {dock}.

steps.title: Refine your ore
lines: Open the Refinery tab and refine some ore into Alloy Plate.
Plate is what ship parts are made of.

steps.title: Place a part
lines: Click Open hangar on the station's Overview tab.
Pick Hull on the left, click next to your ship, then Save.

steps.title: Add a generator
lines: On the Power tab, place the Cell Reactor we gave you, then Save.
Press {powerFlow} to see power flow: an out port must meet an in port.

steps.title: The repair bank
lines: The repair bank keeps materials that rebuild damaged parts.
Close the hangar, then open the station's Repair bank tab.

steps.title: Component guide and map
lines: Leave the station with {dock}.
Press {components} for the component guide, then {map} for the map.

steps.title: Build in the field
lines: Edit your ship out here too: press {fieldBuild} for the build view.
You need to be out of the station.

steps.title: Plan a part
lines: Pick Hull on the left, click next to your ship, then Save.
Saving is free: a new part is only planned.

steps.title: Watch it build
lines: Press {fabricator} to switch your fabricator on.
It builds the planned hull from your hold. Close the view with {fieldBuild}.

steps.title: Jump to the marker
lines: Zoom out with the wheel, or press {map}, to see the Jump here ring.
Put the cursor inside the ring and press {jump} to jump there.

steps.title: Ready to fly
lines: That is the whole loop. Take your starter pack into Sol.
